page.title: Timetables
page.description: The week for any section, lab group, teacher or room.

empty.noTermBody: Add the term’s dates first, then come back to make its timetable.
empty.noTimetableEditor: Generate one from the term’s setup. It takes about a minute, and nobody else sees it until you publish it.
empty.noTimetableViewer: Your timetable coordinator has not published one yet. Please check again later.
empty.nothingBody: This timetable has no sections, teachers or rooms in it.

error.title: We couldn’t show this timetable
error.body: Something went wrong while loading it. Please try again.

version.label: Version
version.draftNote: This is a draft. Only timetable coordinators can see it until it is published.
version.archivedNote: This is an older version. The published one is in the Version list.
version.unplaced: {count, plural, one {# class} other {# classes}} could not be placed.

grid.caption: Week timetable for {name}
grid.phoneHint: On a phone, the timetable is shown one day at a time.

generate.title: Generate a timetable
generate.description: Slotwise places every class of the term so that no section, teacher or room is double-booked.
generate.wholeTerm: Every running class of the term
generate.timeHint: Searching longer can find a timetable with fewer gaps and late periods.
generate.doneBody: {placed, plural, one {# class} other {# classes}} placed. {unplaced, plural, =0 {Every class has a place.} one {# class could not be placed.} other {# classes could not be placed.}}
generate.draftNote: The result is a draft. Nobody else sees it until you publish it.
generate.lostTrack: We lost track of this run. Open Timetables to see if the draft is there.
generate.notAllowedTitle: Only timetable coordinators can generate timetables
generate.notAllowedBody: Ask your institute admin if you need to.
generate.resolveDescription: Locked classes stay where they are; Slotwise places everything else again. The result is a new draft.

edit.resolveHint: Keeps locked classes where they are and places everything else again.
edit.copyHint: Published timetables don’t change. Edit a copy, then publish it.
edit.dragHint: Drag a class to a highlighted period, or use Move. Changes save straight away; Undo takes them back.
edit.phoneNote: To change the timetable, use a tablet or computer.
edit.moveNone: There is no free time for this class this week.
edit.movedRoom: Moved {code} to {day} {periods}, in room {room} because its room was taken.

problems.locked: {code} is locked. Unlock it to move it.
problems.outside_day: It doesn’t fit before the end of {day}.
problems.fixed_slot: This time is kept free for {label}.
problems.faculty_day_limit: {name} would teach more than {max} periods on {day}.
problems.no_free_room: No suitable room is free on {day} {periods}.

unplaced.title: Not placed ({count})
unplaced.intro: These classes have no period yet. Fix the cause, then re-solve or generate again.

reason.no_free_slot: No period where the section, the teacher and a room are all free.
reason.faculty_unavailable: The teacher is unavailable whenever it could go.
reason.faculty_over_max: It would go over the teacher’s daily or weekly limit.
reason.no_suitable_room: There is no room of the right type.
reason.room_too_small: The rooms of the right type are too small for this class.
reason.lab_block_does_not_fit: The lab block doesn’t fit between breaks on any day.
reason.blocked_by_fixed_slot: Fixed periods (mentoring, library…) block every option.
reason.locked_conflict: A locked class is in the way.
reason.time_limit: The search ran out of time before placing it.

fix.unlock: Unlock classes in this timetable, then re-solve.

publish.hint: Everyone in these sections sees it straight away. You can undo.
publish.hasUnplaced: {count, plural, one {# class is} other {# classes are}} not placed yet. You can still publish.
publish.published: Published as version {number}. Students and teachers see it now.
publish.undoneBack: Publishing undone. Version {number} is published again. Your changes are in this draft.
publish.undoneNone: Publishing undone. Nothing is published now. Your changes are in this draft.

export.title: Download or copy
export.csvLabel: Copy {name} as CSV, to paste into a spreadsheet
export.copied: Copied. Paste it into Excel or Google Sheets.
export.copyFailed: This browser didn’t allow copying. Select the text below and copy it, or download Excel.
export.all: Every {kind, select, section {section} subgroup {lab group} faculty {teacher} other {room}}
export.allLabel: Download every {kind, select, section {section} subgroup {lab group} faculty {teacher} other {room}} as Excel, one sheet each
